correctness.rationale: The adaptive next-unvisited-card index is deterministic conditional on already inspected values and strictly increases; by permutation exchangeability its revealed values are sampling without replacement. The unordered first t physical cards have uniform t-subset law, proving the exact coefficient generating formula. Verified independently by enumerating full distinct decks for (m,n)=(1,5),(1,7),(2,4),(3,3), with every survival probability matching the coefficient DP. For fixed m, dominated convergence uses a summable binomial upper bound from counting low cards. For m=1, subtract pair-collision tuples from all positive compositions with total <=n-1, giving coefficient t(t²-t+4)/(4t!n) and O_t(n^-2). A summable uniform n-times-tail-error bound justifies summing in t, yielding 7e/4. Additional n=60,120,240 exact DP means converge toward this coefficient. The continuous renewal law and its e mean are expressly prior results.
